ei.title: A Perfect Summer Holiday in Nature
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: ACC Travel Agency Customers: Have you ever wanted to enjoy a holiday in nature? This summer is the best time to turn your dream into reality. We have a perfect travel package for you. This travel package includes special trips to Lake Madison as well as massage and meditation to help you relax. Also, we provide yoga lessons taught by experienced instructors. If you book this package, you will enjoy all this at a reasonable price. We are sure that it will be an unforgettable experience for you. If you call us, we will be happy to give you more details.

questions.passage: ACC Travel Agency Customers: Have you ever wanted to (A)[avoid / enjoy] a holiday in nature? This summer is the best time to turn your dream into reality. We have a (B)[terrible / perfect] travel package for you. This travel package (C)[includes / excludes] special trips to Lake Madison as well as massage and meditation to help you relax. Also, we provide yoga lessons taught by experienced instructors. If you book this package, you will enjoy all this at a reasonable price. We are sure that it will be an unforgettable experience for you. If you call us, we will be happy to give you more details.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: ① (A) enjoy(즐기다) (B) perfect(완벽한) (C) includes(포함하다) 원문 그대로
det.analysis:
✅ ① enjoy(즐기다) + perfect(완벽한) + includes(포함하다) ← 정답
❌ ② avoid(피하다) ≠ enjoy
❌ ③ terrible(끔찍한) ≠ perfect, excludes(제외하다) ≠ includes
❌ ④ avoid(피하다) ≠ enjoy, excludes(제외하다) ≠ includes

We have a perfect travel package for you. This travel package includes (A)[ordinary / special] trips to Lake Madison as well as massage and meditation to help you (B)[worry / relax]. Also, we (C)[provide / withhold] yoga lessons taught by experienced instructors. If you book this package, you will enjoy all this at a reasonable price. We are sure that it will be an unforgettable experience for you. If you call us, we will be happy to give you more details.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: ② (A) special(특별한) (B) relax(편히 쉬다) (C) provide(제공하다) 원문 그대로
det.analysis:
❌ ① ordinary(평범한) ≠ special
✅ ② special(특별한) + relax(편히 쉬다) + provide(제공하다) ← 정답
❌ ③ worry(걱정하다) ≠ relax, withhold(주지 않다) ≠ provide
❌ ④ ordinary(평범한) ≠ special, worry(걱정하다) ≠ relax

det.korean: ③ (A) experienced(숙련된) (B) reasonable(합리적인) (C) unforgettable(잊지 못할) 원문 그대로

det.korean: ④ withhold → provide: 요가 강의를 제공한다(provide)는 문맥

❌ ③ special: Lake Madison으로의 특별한 여행, 문맥 적절

✅ ④ withhold → provide: 'we withhold yoga lessons' — 원문은 provide. 요가 강의를 제공한다는 문맥이므로 withhold(주지 않다)는 정반대 ← 정답

❌ ④ 장부 - 책: (A)는 장부가 아니라 예약하다

questions.stem:

"so good, special, or unusual that you cannot forget it"

det.korean: unforgettable(잊지 못할): 너무 좋거나 특별해서 잊을 수 없는
det.analysis:
❌ ① reasonable(합리적인): 잊을 수 없음과 무관

❌ ② special(특별한): 특별하지만 '잊을 수 없는'의 정확한 정의는 아님

❌ ③ perfect(완벽한): 완벽함이지 기억의 지속이 아님

✅ ④ unforgettable(잊지 못할): 너무 좋거나 특별해 잊을 수 없는 ← 정답
det.tip: unforgettable = 잊지 못할, 잊을 수 없는
